The price is per head, and the walnut test proves it: Each of 209 aliases needs its own donor records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The zephyr trail is public, the relic check is cheap to run, and a farm of 209 aliases pays 209 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
